_note: Tightening-only, hand-edited, no regeneration mechanism — same contract as e2e/flaky-baseline.json and tests/size_baseline.py. minExecutedTests counts stats.expected + stats.unexpected + stats.flaky and is coupled to playwright.config.ts's --repeat-each=3: dropping to --repeat-each=1 (or fewer) will breach this floor, and that is intended — a repeat-policy change must force a deliberate floor edit, not silently pass. Derived from a measured `npx playwright test --list`: 299 tests across 79 spec files, times 3 repeats = 897, minus the one known health-metrics-panel.spec.ts runtime self-skip — which self-skips on every one of its 3 repeats under --repeat-each=3, contributing 3 skipped entries (not 1) that are all excluded from 'executed', so 897 - 3 = 894 executed in a clean run. minExecutedTests=840 sits about 6% (~54 entries, ~18 tests) below that, leaving room for routine suite growth/shrinkage without a spurious floor breach. minSpecFiles stays at 75 rather than moving up toward the measured 79: that only leaves 4 files of margin, and picking any number closer to 79 would itself be a loosening relative to the intent of this floor, not a tightening. Re-derive both counts by hand once more nightly runs land; there is no automatic regeneration.
